rules: Eligibility rules are authored per extracurricular and cannot be invented ad hoc for a desired candidate.
No generic species-based eligibility rule exists.
Medical/accessibility state may constrain participation only when the activity has an explicit requirement and accommodations are represented.
Interests/hobbies affect NPC preference after eligibility and feasibility, not before.
No player-proximity or narrative-convenience weight exists.
The player chooses among valid eligible options; no best club is auto-selected.
When several NPC candidates compete for limited capacity, existing members are preserved and new candidates use deterministic affinity/tiebreak resolution.
Rejected/no-capacity candidates remain un-enrolled rather than forcing roster expansion.
